steps: The Clever Courier Never Gets Hurt (Part III)
A bandage hides the wound, but not the pain behind it.
The moment Teresa falls from the cliff, I throw out my arms and rush toward where she's falling.
But there's no jolt like I expected.
Teresa lands in my arms, light as a feather.
Uh ... that was way easier than I expected… Teresa, did you use some kind of technique...?
Actually, I climb dangerous cliffs all the time, so I'm totally used to falling by now, meow!
I've got at least three ways to land safely.
Using the ledges on the cliff to absorb the force of the fall.
Driving my greatsword into the cliff to stop my fall.
Or spreading out my body to soften the impact when I land.
So you didn't need me to catch you at all?
I just felt safer with you down below. Knowing someone is there to catch me makes my movements a little sharper.
I see ... Well, as long as you are okay.
Mm...! Ah, time to head down! If we don't run now, we might be in real trouble!
True. We'd better shake the Shrubshrews off before they catch up ...
What's the safest way to make our escape...?
Leave it to me! When I was falling down, I happened to spot a small path.
It's hidden by plants so it's only visible from the air. No way the Shrubshrews will catch up with us if we go that way!
Going that way will make the delivery much faster than usual. Let's go, Boss.
Hah... hah... I slipped up... didn’t expect so much walking.==W== The shortcut still took two hours. Teresa, how long does it usually take you to deliver a letter like this?
But since there are people who live in remote places like this, and there are others who want to convey their feelings to them...
Then no matter how long it takes, proper deliveries must be made!
Hang on a sec, I'll be right back.
Heheheh～♪ Do you think the old lady will be happy when she gets the letter?
No matter the distance, a letter still contains a heartfelt message...
Here, try this. The old lady gave us some fruits as a "thank you."
Huh ... Never seen this before. Is it a fruit? Smells really nice ... Munch munch.
Right? She says it's one of the perks of living deep in the forest!
It's so delicious, it honestly makes me feel like all the effort to get here was totally worth it...
Yeah, when you think of it that way, the fruit tastes even sweeter.
Oh right, Boss. Don't throw away the pits.
I'll take them to those Shrubshrews.
Well, I did step on their burrow entrance first.
Also, this delivery route goes right through their territory. If I stay on good terms with them, there won't be any trouble next time.
But right now, they're probably still holding a grudge against you.
It's fine. Worst case, we just duke it out. Last time was on a cliff, but on flat ground, I'm not scared of them at all.
I can dodge all their attacks.
On the way back, Teresa does dodge every attack from the Shrubshrews.
She also successfully calms the Shrubshrews with the fruit pits.
We make it back to Post Haste in the early evening.
Please have a seat, Boss. I'll get you some tea.
No need for that. You've had a long day already.
That mountain trail is no big deal. You're my guest, Boss. Sit back and let me be the host.
The tea ... I think the tea leaves are on the second floor.
Teresa nimbly hops up the stairs and vanishes in an instant, so I just sit down and relax.
Teresa moves so quickly and thinks through every detail, so how does she end up bruised all over?
I ... I fell from the stairs.
I just forgot I wasn't wearing shoes and was running so fast. I stubbed my pinky toe going upstairs. Then I tripped and fell, hehe.
I'm totally used to it, no problem at all. Seriously, don't worry about it, meow.
And look, I've even got medical tape on right here. It's totally fine!
Sigh. I need to borrow your first aid kit.
Eh, what are you doing, Boss?
W-Wait, hold on?! Why are you inching towards me without saying anything～!
You can barely stand, so stop trying to act tough.
When it hurts, you have to say it out loud. Got it?
Nyaaaaa?!==W== Boss, stop!==W== Don't be rough!
Settle down... I'll put some medicine on.
M-Medicine?!==W== I don't need any!==W== It's too much to ask from you anyway...
B-Besides, it's the kind of injury that should heal on its own.==W== See? Look here!==W== This is where I got hurt before, and it's all healed up!
There's a scar... It wasn't disinfected, was it?
H-Hey! Seriously, wait!==W== No!==W== No antiseptic!==W== L-Look, I'm pretty tough!==W== I don't need any antiseptic!
I'm totally fine with it!==W== Gyaaaaahhh!!!
O-Ow! It stings!==W== Yowch! Yowch!==W== Ugh...!==W== B-Boss...!==W== I'm begging you! No more, please!
So, you really can't deal with it.
Ugh... Yeah.==W== No,==W== I can't... I can't deal with it.
It's like the pain echoes through my whole body and I just can't!==W== What...?==W== Wait.==W== It suddenly doesn't hurt as much==W== after you disinfect it...
There's a right way to do it. And I got a bandage on there for you.
Th-Thank you!==W== Hm?==W== This bandage...==W== it's so cute!
Is this yours,==W== Boss?==W== I wouldn't have expected it,==W== but... I like it!
We should probably put some more antiseptic on.
Yikes!==W== No, I think I'm good!==W== Please, Boss!==W== No more, please?
Alright, alright. Since you know it hurts, try to be more careful next time, okay?
You can safely land from falling off cliffs...==B== But you still fall into those in-your-face holes, and even trip inside your own home.
Cliffs are dangerous, so I stay on high alert.
Maybe it's because once I'm somewhere safe, I let my guard down...?
If that's the case, then you're way too careless.
No, uh, it's only because I'm so relaxed when I'm with you, Boss.
When I'm with you, I tend to pay more attention on you than on the dangers around me...
Got it. I'll try to come here less often from now on.
No no no! That's not what I meant! You should come more often!
Next time I see you, I'll wrap myself up in bandages ahead of time so I won't get hurt.
That's taking it a bit too far. Alright, I was just kidding. Sorry.
In Sailstead there's a shop that sells old broken Artifacts. Lots of them, and affordable, too.
Eh, really?! If you want to go, I'd love to come along, meow!
Sure. But… This time, don't get hurt again, okay?
If you can promise me that, I'll take you.
Got it. I'll do my best to go a week without injury!
In the end, Teresa was extra careful not to get hurt. She did manage to achieve her "one week without injury" goal.
However, the very next day, she got so excited heading out that she smacked her forehead on the door frame.
Going a week without injury is so hard, meow~
